data.gender_notes: Maarifah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maarifah refers to the acquisition of knowledge, wisdom, and understanding in the Islamic context. It's derived from the Arabic word 'arafa' which means 'to know'. The name signifies a person who is constantly seeking knowledge and enriching her mind and soul. The name Maarifah carries the meaning “Knowledge, education, learning” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maarifah usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, education, learning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
